title: Information Processing-Magnetic Tape Cassette and Cartridge Labelling and File Structure for Information Interchange
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12660) covers Information Processing-Magnetic Tape Cassette and Cartridge Labelling and File Structure for Information Interchange. This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 4341 : 1978 'Information processing -Magnetic tape cassette and cartridge labelling and file structure for information interchange*, issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the recommendation of the Connputers, Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee (LTDC 24) and approval of the Electronic and Telecommunication Division Council, In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard.' b) Comma ( . ) has been used as a decinrial marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point < . ) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
